entries.title: Five cities to fly
entries.body: Fly your paper plane over Paris, New York, Tokyo, Cairo and Rio de Janeiro. Each new city downloads once, then plays offline.
entries.play: Five cities to fly: Paris, New York, Tokyo, Cairo and Rio de Janeiro

entries.title: The porcelain keepers
entries.body: Two souvenir keepers guard each city's wish. Fly into their arena, switch lanes and strike when a piece glints.
entries.play: Porcelain keepers to wake and break in every city

entries.title: Draw a better plane
entries.body: Spend what each flight earns in the garage: a stronger launcher, wider wings, tougher paper, an engine and a tank.
entries.play: A garage to upgrade your launcher, wings, paper, engine and tank

entries.title: Hidden treasures
entries.body: Rare finds hide in every city's streets. The Atlas gives you a riddle for each one you haven't found yet.
entries.play: Hidden treasures, with a riddle in the Atlas for each one

entries.title: Easy or Medium
entries.body: Pick how you want to fly on each city's card, before you throw.

entries.title: Fly it again
entries.body: Replay a city you've cleared with a fresh plane, and look for the treasures you missed.

entries.title: Hard mode
entries.body: A tougher way to fly each city, for when Medium feels easy.

entries.title: More cities
entries.body: London, Sydney, Beijing, Rome and San Francisco are already on the wishlist. They will arrive in a later update.
